english.title: Attempt to possess with intent to supply a controlled drug of Class C - 4-Hydroxy-n-butyric acid (GHB)
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to have in your possession

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE QUANTITY..)]_
(B)_[a quantity]_

of 4-Hydroxy-n-butyric acid, a controlled drug of Class C, with intent to supply it to **(..SPECIFY NAME..) in contravention of section 4(1) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(3) of, and Schedule 4 to, the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 and section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.

investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order
Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: 4-Hydroxy-n-butyric acid (GHB) has been reclassified from a Class C to a Class B drug from 13th April 2022; for offences committed on or after that date see H102342.
